description: Group of uniformed girls posing with basketball and dog under a basketball hoop. Georgia O'Keeffe is fourth from the left. Handwriting on verso. Possibly taken while O'Keeffe was at Chatham Episcopal Institute.

title: Beta Chapter of Kappa Delta with Basketball
